title: Extract IPv4 addresses
hints: Start with the shape only: r"(?:\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}" and re.findall. Then filter the candidates with a Python check.
For each candidate, split on '.' and check every group: int(o) <= 255 and not (len(o) > 1 and o.startswith('0')).
\b is not enough to stop '10.1.2.3.4' matching, because '.' is a word boundary. Use lookarounds: (?<![\d.]) before the pattern and (?![\d.]) after it.
